notes.title: Update 1.6.2 - Released
notes.content:
Hello Slimesventure Friends!
O[b][/b]nce again, a very long time has passed since our last update! But now it's time again.

We start with a Slimesventure: Your Destination update, which, as announced, will mainly focus on fixing bugs so that we can concentrate on the new upcoming game. 

The first post about the new game is expected to appear on our website next week, but for now, let's take a look at the patch notes for the new Update 1.6.2 Bug Destruction:

[h1]Patch Notes - Update 1.6.2 Bug Destruction:[/h1]

[h2]Critical Changes[/h2]
- After day 7, game crashed through parsing error – [b]fixed[/b]
- Items can be crafted without needed Resources, leaded to game crash – [b]fixed[/b]

[h2]FunctionalChanges[/h2]
- Wheater doesn’t have the same typ two days in a row. – [b]updated[/b]
- Opening different panels in main menu causes overlaping, if not disabling the previous one – [b]fixed[/b]
- First day starts now at: 6am -> 10am – [b]updated[/b]
- “Tell me the next day” – Wizard – [b]removed[/b]
- Stamina is now first fully regenerating, when fully used – [b]added[/b]

[h2]Graphical Changes[/h2]
- Loading Bar not visible anymore, when Newsletter appeared the next day – [b]updated[/b]
- Buildings lights are now visible, when the night appear – [b]updated[/b]
- No overwhelming lightintensity, when entering a building the first time – [b]fixed[/b]
- Better colors and crafting buttons in crafting menu – [b]updated[/b]
- Stamina bar better colors and text – [b]updated[/b]
- Ending credit scene had lost image – [b]updated[/b]
- Menu credit window now has a splash image leading to this website – [b]added[/b]
- Prologue sequences play now at 10 am to have a more sunny appearence – [b]updated[/b]
- Menu now has moving gras – [b]updated[/b]
- Text content and formation – [b]updated[/b]
- Many collision, layer and lightning bugs – [b]fixed[/b]

[h2]Audio Changes[/h2]
- Atmosphere does now play in loop, to prevent silence – [b]updated[/b]
- Music plays at day start and at 6pm switching to night music – [b]updated[/b]
- Slime jumping sound, doesn’t play anymore, when time is stopped (Menus, Dialogues…) – [b]updated[/b]

Thanks as always to all people, who play and played - Slimesventure: Your Destination!

Continue enjoying,
Leon

notes.title: Update 1.5 - WinterLife Preview
notes.content:
Hello Slimesventure friends!
We wanted to give you a preview of the upcoming Update 1.5 WinterLife as the end of the year draws near.

It's about to get wintry in the Slimesventure universe.

[h2]New Zone[/h2]

We are adding a winter area below the Hill Plains with the new update. It will also be possible to reach this area by train.

[h2]New items & a new quest to complete[/h2]

There will be new items available in the new area that you can add to your personal collection of items. A related quest will guide you through the new area.

[h2]The Seasons[/h2]

We are adding the 4 main seasons of the year to the game - Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter. The chance of a weather type will change depending on the season.

[h2]New type of climate[/h2]

For the winter season, we are adding a snowstorm. This will be available during the winter season. We will also be adding effects to the weather, such as a slowdown during snowstorms or rain.

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

There will also be new Achievements for the new area to collect.

These are the changes planned for the 1.5 WinterLife update. The update is already well underway. However, it may differ from the information provided here.


Thanks as always to all people, who play Slimesventure: Your Destination!

Continue enjoying,
Leon

notes.title: Slimesventure: Your Destination – 1. Year Anniversary
notes.content:
Hello Community, the time has finally come, [b]Slimesventure: Your Destination – 1. Year Anniversary[/b] is today! Exactly one year ago, we published this project on Steam and for almost 2 years, this project has accompanied us in our daily work.

[h2]What concerns us most.[/h2]
Slimesventure: Your Destination had a focus on exploration at the beginning. Over time, more ideas crept in to encourage players to explore the map, see new areas and discover things, like main and side quests. Time Management was designed to challenge the player to get as much done as possible in as little time as possible. Of course, there was not much time to explore for long periods of time, as you had to concentrate on your next objective.

But we always missed the [u][b]sound design[/b][/u], especially when you were travelling to collect resources, trade or explore a new area. Each section of the map has its own atmosphere, and we weren’t really able to convey that to the player.

[h2]Our next steps[/h2]
But in order to get back on a positive track and to make Slimesventure: Your Destination even better, the next update will be [u][i][b]“Sound & Atmosphere 1.4”[/b][/i][/u], where (presumably) each map section will get its own music and atmosphere. We are also adding more sound effects and change many of the currently existing ones. This will make the game even more lively and gives a much better player experience.

We do not yet have an exact release date for the 1.4 update. However, it is expected that it will be released sometime between [b][u]October and November.[/u][/b]

I would also like to thank every player who has played Slimesventure and also who has shared their playing experiences and problems with us.

Continue enjoying Slimesventure: Your destination
Leon

tags.feature: We are also adding more sound effects and change many of the currently existing ones.

It's been another 3 months since the last update, but now we're even more excited to announce a new update for you.

[h3]Shop Page[/h3]
As you may have already noticed, we've added a new, re-designed Shop Overlay. The library images have also been improved. Somehow, and we don't know why, the library images were never updated. We hope that this will be done in the near future.
Also, the first 18 Achievements collectable with Update 1.3 are already set.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
- A new side quest called "The Lost Medallion" has been added to the game.
- A total of 18 Achievements have been added to guide you through the game.
- A number of minor in-game bugs have been fixed
- Various information signs added for a better exploration experience
- The inventory tutorial window has had some enhancements and adjustments.

- Added nicer animation to the text box
- Surfaces such as the shops have been given animations or have been improved.
(Update 1.4 will include graphic updates)
- Slimesventure: Your destination now has a more fluid logo

- Some of the textures and tile sets have been improved
- The menu has been expanded and made more attractive
- More voluminous vegetation in the beach area

These are the major components of the upcoming 1.3 upgrade.
[h3]Update 1.3 is expected to be released in the coming days.[/h3]

[h2]Update 1.4 Preview[/h2]
Viewpoint 06-09-2023:
- More interesting beach in the beach area
- More activity in the prologue scene
- More characters who are in the Slimesventure universe

Continue enjoying Slimesventure: Your destination
Leon

notes.title: Update 1.2 Preview
notes.content:
Hello Community!

After some free time and exams at the university, we are proud to announce the next upcoming update 1.2 for our latest game: Slimesventure: Your Destination.

This update mainly contains changes for the player kingdom area.

[list]
[*] Liveliness
The area is mostly quiet and has only a few animations that can be seen on the screen. To make things livelier, we decided to add more people and animals to the environment, making the scene more interesting and appealing.

[*] Buildings & Upgrade Levels
Most of our buildings only consist of 1-2 stages of upgrading. In this upcoming update, ALL buildings will have 3 upgradelevels.

The current upgrade/construction animation needs to be changed. So we have decided to give each individual building a unique and custom upgrade animation. This animation will be played every time that specific building is constructed / upgraded with textures that are appropriate for its current level of upgrade.

[*] Overlay and Gameplay
The player needs to have a better view of the things that are going on in their own kingdom. The first thing we are going to change is the overlay of the kingdom itself. The current amount of each item that is stored and the amount that will be produced the next day will be designed to be cleaner and easier for the player to read. The overlay will also be smaller in general, so that it doesn’t take up as much of the screen as it did before.

In addition the overlay of the kingdom storage will have a better design and those Items can also be viewed in an additional overlay, so that you don’t need to be in the near of the storage chests anymore.

In terms of gameplay, the current combat system will be overhauled. Currently, there are points that need to be fulfilled before you can conquer the next location. These points will be changed to recommendations. So you can always start a conquest to the next location. The chance of winning the next conquest will be listed each time you are about to conquer. The change depends on the Food and Soldiers.

To make things even more interesting, you now have to feed your soldiers on a daily basis. The time you start a conquest will also affect the chances of winning, due to fatigue and reduced visibility.

[*] Balancing of productions and construction costs
With the upcoming update 1.2, the production of each building and its construction costs + Craftingrecipies, will be adjusted to provide a better player experience and make the days leading up to the King’s Assault even closer and more exciting.

[/list]

This were the latest news for the upcoming update 1.2 of Slimesventure: Your Destination.

Thankfully,

Leon

notes.title: Update 1.1 Preview
notes.content:
Hello Community,

this month the [b]28th of October the Update 1.1[/b] for Slimesventure: Your Destination is planned and will presumably include the following content additions/ or changes:

[u][b]1. Adding a Progloue[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The introduction sequence to the game is short and contains barely any information about the prehistory until the time of the beginning of the game. In order to change this,[b] a complete prologue with sequences and back story telling[/b] will be added with the upcoming update, which can be played by the player in a [b]mixed combination of Gameplay and Sequences.[/b]
[/list]
[u][b]2. Improving graphical Elements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] As a graphical artist and game designer, textures and terrains are not constantly appealing. Correspondingly, [b]some of the old elements will be revised and improved.[/b]
[/list]
[u][b]3. Expanding the Content of consisting Terrain[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] A open world is nothing without its details that make it interesting. To overcome this, there will be no additional areas in this update. Instead, some of the [b]existing areas will be expanded in their size and content.[/b]
[/list]

After the release of Update 1.1, there will be a detailed list of all patch notes in the update post.

Sincerely,
Leon
